_notes: Aosong AHT20 (also AHT21/AHT25/DHT20) at 0x38. Data format: Status(8bit) + Humidity(20bit) + Temperature(20bit) (+ CRC, not read). Conversion: humidity(%) = (H[19:0]/2^20)*100, temp(°C) = (T[19:0]/2^20)*200-50. Detection: a bare read of the status byte with bits 6:5 = 0 - weak, but it passes idle (0x1C), measuring (busy bit 7 set: the AHT20 answers rather than NACKing) and just after a soft reset (0x80, calibration bit clear), so it can't fail on a genuine part; a Trill Ring's reply starts 0xFE. Init: calibrate (0xBE0800), 10 ms. Poll: trigger (0xAC3300), 80 ms (the measurement time; a read before then gives incomplete data with a valid CRC), read 6 bytes.
